news.title: Levi Colwill accepts there is a 'lot to work on' after Brentford defeat
news.title_zh: 列维·科尔威尔承认布伦特福德失利后还有“很多工作要做”
news.body_en: Disappointment was etched across the face of Levi Colwill as he undertook the post-match media duties following our 3-0 defeat at Brentford. It was a result, as our captain for the night admitted, that hurt. The final scoreline didn't necessarily reflect Chelsea's performance at the Gtech Community Stadium. We controlled much of the opening period, limiting Brentford to just one shot on target despite a barrage of long throw-ins. We had created a couple of opportunities of our own, with Caoimhin Kelleher denying Pedro Neto and Morgan Rogers, who also had a late first-half attempt blocked on its way to goal. As the players emerged for the second half, the game was delicately poised. Unfortunately, it tipped the way of the hosts. Jaidon Anthony headed home just after the hour mark, Igor Thiago then netted, and Fabio Carvalho put gloss on Brentford's victory in stoppage time. It was a disappointing evening for the Blues. Colwill, who skippered the side in Reece James' absence due to injury, was honest in his reflection on the performance. He accepted the second-half display was not good enough, and that there must be an improvement defensively. ‘It was tough,' the 23-year-old explained. 'First of all, conceding from a set-piece isn’t the best, and then we tried to push and maybe over-exposed ourselves and played some passes we shouldn’t and forced it. 'I feel we needed to relax and not push too hard for the equaliser; we needed to believe it would come if we continued playing our football. But I think we pushed too hard to get it and they hurt us on the counter. 'They get the second goal and then the third goal really hit home and hurt. The second half we weren’t good enough, obviously, and we’ve got a lot to work on during the international break.' For the first time under Xabi Alonso – and the first time this season in all competitions – the Blues failed to find the net. Joao Pedro was also absent due to injury, with the Brazilian replaced by Danny Welbeck, who netted in our previous two Carabao Cup fixtures, in the side. Yet Colwill insisted that, no matter who is deployed in attack, a solid defence is required to give us a platform to win games. He said: 'We can’t rely on the front three to pull us out of danger; the rest of us have to try to help as much as possible. The defence, the midfield and the attackers, we all need to help each other much more. 'We’ve definitely got a lot of room to improve.'
news.body_zh: 在我们0-3输给布伦特福德后，利瓦伊·科尔威尔在承担赛后媒体职责时，脸上写满了失望。正如我们当晚的队长所承认的那样，这个结果令人痛苦。最终比分并不一定反映切尔西在 Gtech 社区体育场的表现。我们控制了开局的大部分时间，尽管有大量的长界外球，但限制了布伦特福德只有一脚射中目标。我们自己创造了几次机会，曹伊欣·凯莱赫挡出了佩德罗·内托和摩根·罗杰斯的射门，后者在上半场最后时刻的射门也被挡出。下半场，随着球员们陆续登场，比赛陷入了微妙的平衡。不幸的是，它改变了东道主的方式。一小时后杰登·安东尼头球破门，伊戈尔·蒂亚戈进球，法比奥·卡瓦略在补时阶段为布伦特福德的胜利锦上添花。对于蓝军来说，这是一个令人失望的夜晚。科尔威尔在里斯·詹姆斯因伤缺席期间担任球队队长，他对球队的表现诚实地进行了反思。他承认下半场的表现不够好，防守方面必须有所改进。 “这很艰难，”23 岁的他解释道。 “首先，定位球丢球并不是最好的，然后我们试图逼抢，也许过度暴露了自己，并传出了一些我们不应该传球的传球，并强迫传球。 “我觉得我们需要放松，不要太用力去扳平比分；我们需要相信，如果我们继续踢足球，它就会到来。但我认为我们太努力了，他们在柜台上伤害了我们。 “他们进了第二个球，然后第三个球真的击中了要害并伤害了他们。显然，下半场我们表现得不够好，在国际比赛日期间我们还有很多工作要做。”在哈维·阿隆索的带领下，蓝军第一次未能进球，这也是本赛季在所有比赛中第一次。若奥·佩德罗也因伤缺席，巴西人被丹尼·维尔贝克顶替，他在我们之前两场卡拉宝杯比赛中进球。但科尔威尔坚持认为，无论谁在进攻中部署，都需要坚实的防守才能为我们提供赢得比赛的平台。他说：“我们不能依靠前三名来把我们从危险中拉出来；我们其他人必须尽力提供​​帮助。后防线、中场和前锋，我们都需要更多地互相帮助。 “我们肯定还有很大的改进空间。”

news.title: Alonso: ‘It’s not about talking or looking for excuses’
news.title_zh: 阿隆索：“这不是谈论或寻找借口”
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso felt his Chelsea team were punished for not being able to maintain the required levels to compete against Brentford over the course of 90 minutes, with our manager stressing he is not ‘looking for excuses’ for the defeat. The Blues were the better team before the interval, but the Bees took charge in the second period and broke the deadlock through Jaidon Anthony on the hour. We tried to muster a response, yet our hosts made sure of the result with two late goals, leaving Alonso to reflect on a second defeat so far this season. ‘I’m disappointed at the end with the second half and the result,’ he said. ‘This is not enough to compete in the Premier League, not to be able to go for the 90 minutes. This is why today we were punished. ‘At the moment, we are not being consistent enough to compete during the whole game – 45 [minutes] is not enough, you need to play the whole game knowing each detail is important and each action can be decisive. ‘We dropped our consistency, and our competitive mentality needed in the second half. It's about 95 minutes, and we have not been able to keep that level throughout these few games in the start of the season. It's something that we'll have to do better.’ Alonso had to make do without his captain, Reece James, and arguably our top performer so far this season, Joao Pedro. Both were ruled out because of injury. But our manager was at pains to not use the duo’s absence to explain away the result at the Gtech Community Stadium. ‘It’s not about talking or looking for excuses,’ said Alonso. ‘We need to look at each other and know we have to work and improve. 'There is still a long way to go, but we have to check many things.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索认为他的切尔西队因无法在 90 分钟内保持与布伦特福德的比赛所需的水平而受到惩罚，我们的主教练强调他并没有为失败“寻找借口”。蓝军在中场休息前表现更好，但蜜蜂队在第二节占据主导地位，并在比赛结束时通过杰登·安东尼打破了僵局。我们试图做出回应，但我们的东道主在最后时刻的两个进球确保了结果，让阿隆索反思了本赛季迄今为止的第二场失利。 “我对下半场的结束和结果感到失望，”他说。 “这不足以参加英超联赛，无法踢满 90 分钟。这就是今天我们受到惩罚的原因。 “目前，我们在整场比赛中的稳定性还不够——45分钟是不够的，你需要打整场比赛，知道每个细节都很重要，每个动作都具有决定性。” “我们失去了稳定性，也失去了下半场所需的竞争心态。大约是95分钟，我们在赛季初的这几场比赛中都没能保持这个水平。这是我们必须做得更好的事情。”阿隆索不得不在没有他的队长里斯·詹姆斯和可以说是我们本赛季迄今为止表现最好的球员若昂·佩德罗的情况下生存。两人均因伤缺席。但我们的经理煞费苦心地不利用两人的缺席来解释 Gtech 社区体育场的结果。 “这不是谈论或寻找借口，”阿隆索说。 “我们需要互相审视，知道我们必须努力并改进。 “还有很长的路要走，但我们必须检查很多事情。”

news.title: Match report: Brentford 3-0 Chelsea
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：布伦特福德 3-0 切尔西
news.body_en: Three second-half goals condemned Chelsea to defeat at the Gtech Community Stadium in our final fixture before the international break. Chelsea were the better side in the opening 45 minutes, with Pedro Neto drawing an excellent save from Caoimhin Kelleher and Morgan Rogers having a goalbound shot blocked. However, it was Brentford who came out the blocks faster following the interval and they scored what felt like it would be a pivotal opener through Jaidon Anthony’s close-range header on the hour. As we pressed for an equaliser, we were caught on the break late on. Igor Thiago doubled the Bees lead and Fabio Carvalho made it 3-0 with virtually the last kick, condemning us to a first defeat at the Gtech Community Stadium. Xabi Alonso made five alterations to his side, handing Jordan Henderson a Chelsea debut and three other players their first start in the Premier League. Pep Chavarria, Valentin Barco, and Danny Welbeck were all included in the XI, with Maxence Lacroix the other fresh face in the side. Two of the changes were enforced, with Reece James and Joao Pedro unavailable, while Malo Gusto, Jorrel Hato and Romeo Lavia dropped to the bench. They were joined there by 16-year-old Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli, who was named in a matchday squad for the first time and would come on to make his Blues debut. A crackling Friday night atmosphere greeted the teams and after a brief spell of Brentford pressure, we began to assert our dominance on the contest. Cole Palmer danced his way into the box but was eventually crowded out before he could shoot. Chavarria was a regular outlet down our left and from one cross in the tenth minute, Welbeck teed up Pedro Neto. His first-time shot was well saved by Kelleher. By the midway point of the half, we had limited the home side’s threat to a handful of set-pieces and long throws, passing the test on every occasion. The Blues were mixing up our attacks, using width on occasion but also allowing Rogers to drift infield and link up with Palmer. It was from a central position that our no.17’s goalbound shot – from Chavarria’s intelligent pass – hit Jannik Schuster and fizzed behind. It had not been an opening 45 minutes full of opportunities, but this unfamiliar Chelsea side could certainly be satisfied with their efforts as the teams headed down the tunnel with it all still to play for. The second half started in similar fashion: keenly contested, but with space in the final third at a premium. Brentford improved, too, and five minutes in, Emi Martinez got the feintest of touches on an Anthony header that hit the top of the crossbar, but the offside flag was up anyway. Not long after, our keeper launched a counter-attack with a diagonal pass that Chavarria latched on to. He opted to shoot and though Kelleher was worried, the ball flew wide. Brentford went straight up the other end and scored. Damsgaard’s corner from the left was met by Schuster, who headed back across goal for an unmarked Anthony to nod into the net from a couple of yards out. We very nearly levelled matters up from a corner of our own. Henderson’s vicious delivery was missed by Kelleher but the ricochet didn’t quite land in our favour, with the Bees smuggling the ball clear. Our hosts twice looked threatening on the break but couldn’t make the most of their men over, and then we really started to ramp up the pressure, pinning Brentford back and winning corner after corner. From one, Barco had a good appeal for a penalty waved away, with his attempt one of several in quick succession that were met by a red-and-white shirt flinging themselves in the line of fire. We had five shots blocked between the 66th and the 80th minute. But it was Brentford who got the game’s second goal. Schade was set free and though Martinez did excellently to save his shot, the rebound fell to Thiago who couldn’t miss. Alonso brought Nicoll-Jazuli on for his senior debut late on, and there was still time for Brentford to extend their lead, Carvalho firing home at the far post after Schade’s cross had been deflected kindly into his path. The Blues remain on seven points with five league games played. A prolonged international break that lasts until the second week of October. We return to action on Saturday 10 October when Bournemouth come to the Bridge. Chelsea (4-2-3-1): Martinez; Fofana (Acheampong 71), Lacroix, Colwill (c), Chavarria; Henderson, Barco (Nicoll-Jazuli 87); Neto (Estevao 87), Palmer, Rogers; Welbeck (Quenda 71) Unused subs: Penders, Gusto, Hato, Lavia, Gittens Brentford (4-3-3): Kelleher; Kayode (Hickey 69), Ajer, Schuster, Lewis-Potter (Diouf 81); Yarmoliuk (Sangare 69), Janelt (c), Damsgaard (Carvalho 87); Anthony (Ouattara 81), Thiago, SchadeUnused subs: Balcombe, Henry, Wilson, FredrickScorers: Anthony 61, Thiago 83, Carvalho 90+4 Booked: Thiago 84, Sangare 85 Referee Andrew Madley Crowd 17,193
news.body_zh: 下半场的三个进球让切尔西在国际比赛日之前的最后一场比赛中在 Gtech 社区体育场失利。开场 45 分钟，切尔西表现较好，佩德罗·内托 (Pedro Neto) 精彩扑救考伊欣·凯莱赫 (Caoimhin Kelleher)，摩根·罗杰斯 (Morgan Rogers) 的射门被挡出。然而，布伦特福德在中场休息后更快地完成了拦网，他们通过杰登·安东尼(Jaidon Anthony)的近距离头球破门得分，感觉这将是一个关键的揭幕战。当我们力争扳平比分时，我们在中场休息时陷入了困境。伊戈尔·蒂亚戈 (Igor Thiago) 扩大了蜜蜂队的领先优势，而法比奥·卡瓦略 (Fabio Carvalho) 在最后一脚将比分改写为 3-0，这让我们在 Gtech 社区体育场遭遇了首场失利。哈维·阿隆索对球队进行了五次调整，乔丹·亨德森在切尔西首次亮相，其他三名球员则在英超联赛中首次首发。佩普·查瓦里亚、瓦伦丁·巴科和丹尼·维尔贝克都入选了首发阵容，马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦是另一位新面孔。其中两项调整被强制执行，里斯·詹姆斯和若昂·佩德罗无法上场，而马洛·古斯托、乔雷尔·哈托和罗密欧·拉维亚则坐在替补席上。 16 岁的迈赫迪·尼科尔-贾祖利 (Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli) 也加入了他们的行列，他首次入选比赛日大名单，并在上场后首次亮相蓝军。星期五晚上，各支球队的气氛热烈，在短暂的布伦特福德压力之后，我们开始确立我们在比赛中的统治地位。科尔·帕尔默跳进禁区，但最终在射门之前就被挤了出去。查瓦里亚是我们左路的常规出路，第十分钟的一次传中，维尔贝克将佩德罗·内托送入球门。他的第一次射门被凯莱赫成功扑出。到半场中段时，我们将主队的威胁限制在少量的定位球和长传上，每次都通过了考验。蓝军混合了我们的进攻，有时使用宽度，但也让罗杰斯漂移到内场并与帕尔默联系。我们的 17 号球员从中间位置射门——查瓦里亚巧妙的传球——击中了扬尼克·舒斯特尔并在身后嘶嘶作响。开场的 45 分钟并不是充满机会的，但这支陌生的切尔西队肯定会对自己的努力感到满意，因为球队即将进入隧道，一切仍有待争夺。下半场以类似的方式开始：争夺激烈，但最后三分之一的空间非常宝贵。布伦特福德也有所进步，五分钟后，埃米·马丁内斯接到安东尼的头球击中横梁顶部，但越位旗还是举了起来。不久之后，我们的门将发起反击，斜传球被查瓦里亚接住。他选择射门，尽管凯莱赫很担心，但球飞出了边线。布伦特福德直接冲上另一端得分。达姆斯加德从左侧开出角球，舒斯特尔接到球门后回传球，无人盯防的安东尼在几码外头球入网。我们差点就从自己的一个角落里把事情搞平了。亨德森的恶毒传球被凯莱赫错过，但跳弹并没有完全对我们有利，蜜蜂队将球偷偷清除。我们的东道主两次在中场休息时看起来很有威胁，但无法充分利用他们的球员，然后我们开始加大压力，将布伦特福德压制住，赢得一个又一个角球。从一开始，巴科就曾多次提出点球请求，但被判无效，他连续几次尝试都被红白相间的球衣扔进了火线中，这是他的一次尝试。从第 66 分钟到第 80 分钟，我们有 5 次射门被挡出。但布伦特福德打进了比赛的第二个进球。沙德被释放，尽管马丁内斯出色地扑出了射门，但篮板球落到了蒂亚戈身上，蒂亚戈投篮不中。阿隆索在晚些时候让尼科尔-贾祖利上场，完成了他的成年队首秀，布伦特福德还有时间扩大领先优势，在沙德的传中被巧妙地偏转到他的路径上后，卡瓦略在远门柱射门。蓝军在进行了五场联赛后仍积七分。长期的国际假期将持续到十月的第二周。 10 月 10 日星期六，伯恩茅斯将造访蓝桥，我们将重返赛场。 切尔西（4-2-3-1）：马丁内斯；福法纳（Acheampong 71）、拉克鲁瓦、科尔威尔（c）、查瓦里亚；亨德森，巴可（Nicoll-Jazuli 87）；内托 (Estevao 87)、帕尔默、罗杰斯；维尔贝克 (Quenda 71) 未上场替补：彭德斯、古斯托、哈托、拉维亚、吉滕斯 布伦特福德 (4-3-3)：凯莱赫；卡约德（希基 69）、阿耶尔、舒斯特、刘易斯-波特（迪乌夫 81）；亚莫柳克 (Sangare 69)、贾内特 (c)、达姆斯加德 (Carvalho 87)；安东尼（瓦塔拉 81）、蒂亚戈、沙德未使用替补：巴尔科姆、亨​​利、威尔逊、弗雷德里克得分手：安东尼 61、蒂亚戈 83、卡瓦略 90+4 黄牌：蒂亚戈 84、桑加雷 85 裁判安德鲁·马德利·克劳德 17,193

news.title: Xabi Alonso on 'competitive monster' Jordan Henderson and Chelsea absentees
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索谈“竞争怪物”乔丹·亨德森和切尔西的缺席
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has described Jordan Henderson as a 'competitive monster' after handing the midfielder his Chelsea debut at Brentford and explained why Reece James and Joao Pedro are absent this evening. Henderson joined the Blues on a free transfer this summer, but his Blues bow has been delayed due to the broken arm he sustained while away with England at this summer's FIFA World Cup. The 36-year-old has diligently undertaken his recovery at Cobham over the past six weeks and is now ready to make his Chelsea debut – and it comes against the club with whom he spent the previous campaign. On including Henderson in his side against Brentford, Alonso said: ‘The Premier League is about competing and Jordan is a competitive monster. 'I’m sure he will help the team with his quality, his game intelligence and the communication he has. We’re happy to have him back.' Alonso has been unable to call upon several players at the Gtech Community Stadium, with James and Joao Pedro joining Marco Palestra, Moises Caicedo and Emmanuel Emegha on the sidelines. 'Reece picked up a little injury in the last game against Hull and was feeling short in his recovery,' Alonso explained ahead of tonight's game. 'Joao we tried, but we expect to use the international break for him to be back in the next game against Bournemouth.' The Brazilian's absence means Danny Welbeck makes his full Premier League debut for the Blues, and will form part of an attack that includes Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers. 'You need to adapt to the qualities of the players and get the benefit of what they do well,' Alonso explained when asked what Welbeck will offer as part of our front three. 'We know Danny is a reference and links very well. He is intelligent and knows where to play, and if we have a front three that works well it will be better for the team.'
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索在乔丹·亨德森在布伦特福德完成切尔西首秀后将其描述为“有竞争力的怪物”，并解释了里斯·詹姆斯和若昂·佩德罗今晚缺席的原因。亨德森今年夏天免费转会加盟蓝军，但由于他在今年夏天随英格兰队参加世界杯时手臂骨折，他的蓝军出场时间被推迟。过去六周里，这位 36 岁的球员在科巴姆努力康复，现在已经准备好在切尔西首次亮相，而且对手是他上赛季效力的俱乐部。在将亨德森纳入球队对阵布伦特福德的比赛中，阿隆索表示：“英超联赛就是竞争，而乔丹是一个有竞争力的怪物。 “我相信他会凭借自己的能力、比赛智慧和沟通能力为球队提供帮助。我们很高兴他回来了。”阿隆索无法在 Gtech 社区体育场召唤几名球员，詹姆斯和若昂·佩德罗加入了马科·帕莱斯特拉、莫伊塞斯·凯塞多和伊曼纽尔·埃梅加的行列。 “里斯在上一场对阵赫尔城的比赛中受了点伤，感觉恢复时间很短，”阿隆索在今晚的比赛前解释道。 “我们尝试过若奥，但我们希望利用国际比赛日让他在下一场对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中回归。”巴西人的缺席意味着丹尼·维尔贝克将在蓝军的英超联赛中首次亮相，并将成为包括科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯在内的进攻的一部分。当被问及维尔贝克作为我们的前三名球员将提供什么时，阿隆索解释道：“你需要适应球员的素质，并从他们的出色表现中获益。” “我们知道丹尼是一个参考，并且联系非常好。他很聪明，知道在哪里踢球，如果我们有一个运转良好的前场三人组，那对球队来说会更好。”

news.title: Jordan Henderson on making his Chelsea debut at Brentford
news.title_zh: 乔丹·亨德森在布伦特福德完成切尔西首秀
news.body_en: Jordan Henderson has had to wait patiently to make his Chelsea debut. But having recovered from injury, the 36-year-old is in from the start against Brentford tonight and ready to make his mark. Henderson, who spent last season with the Bees, signed for the Blues earlier in the summer on a free transfer. However, having broken his arm while away with England at the FIFA World Cup, his first outing in Blue has been delayed. Tonight at the Gtech Community Stadium, Henderson will step out in a Chelsea shirt for the first time. And the midfielder is looking forward to introducing himself to the Blues faithful. 'Delighted to be back and have the feeling of getting onto the pitch,' Henderson explained ahead of this evening's Premier League clash with Brentford. 'It’s been a while, so I’m just excited to be back. 'It’s been a little frustrating [not being able to play], but I’ve tried to stay as fit as I can to be ready for this opportunity now. I’m just looking forward to it. 'It’s been good to settle in with the team over the last month, even though it’s been frustrating not playing games, but hopefully now I can get involved.' Henderson's illustrious career has seen him play hundreds of games at domestic level, in England and abroad. His last 34 came with Brentford during the 2025/26 campaign, with the England international impressing for the Bees before his departure and eventual switch to Stamford Bridge. It means that Henderson is well-versed in the threat Keith Andrews' side will pose tonight, and has outlined that the Blues will need to perform well to come away with a positive result. He said: 'They’re a fantastic team who can play with the ball, are good on transition and are good in behind. So it will be a very difficult game, as we know, so we’ve got to be 100 per cent to get anything from the game. 'But if we can play the way we know we can, we will cause them problems as well.'
news.body_zh: 乔丹·亨德森必须耐心等待才能完成他的切尔西首秀。但从伤病中恢复后，这位 36 岁的球员在今晚对阵布伦特福德的比赛中首发出场，并准备好留下自己的印记。亨德森上赛季效力于蜜蜂队，今年夏天早些时候以免费转会的方式加盟蓝军。然而，由于他在随英格兰队参加世界杯时摔断了手臂，他在蓝色队的首场比赛被推迟了。今晚在 Gtech 社区体育场，亨德森将首次身着切尔西球衣出场。这位中场球员期待着向蓝军球迷介绍自己。 “很高兴能回来并有上场的感觉，”亨德森在今晚与布伦特福德的英超比赛前解释道。 “已经有一段时间了，所以我很高兴能回来。 “（无法上场）有点令人沮丧，但我已经尽力保持健康，为现在的机会做好准备。我只是期待它。 “过去一个月适应球队的感觉很好，尽管不参加比赛很令人沮丧，但希望现在我能参与其中。”亨德森辉煌的职业生涯见证了他在国内、英格兰和国外踢了数百场比赛。他的最后34场比赛是在2025/26赛季为布伦特福德效力的，这位英格兰国脚在离开并最终转投斯坦福桥之前为蜜蜂队留下了深刻的印象。这意味着亨德森深知基思·安德鲁斯的球队今晚将构成的威胁，并概述了蓝军需要表现出色才能取得积极的结果。他说：“他们是一支出色的球队，能够控球，擅长攻防转换，也擅长后卫。因此，正如我们所知，这将是一场非常困难的比赛，所以我们必须百分百努力才能从比赛中获得任何东西。 “但如果我们能按照我们知道的方式打球，我们也会给他们带来麻烦。”

news.title: Confirmed Chelsea line up vs Brentford
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西对阵布伦特福德的阵容
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has made five changes to his Chelsea team for today’s fixture away to Brentford, with a quartet of Blues handed their full Premier League debut. Pep Chavarria, Valentin Barco, Jordan Henderson and Danny Welbeck are included in Alonso’s starting XI. Reece James and Joao Pedro are unavailable, while Malo Gusto, Jorrel Hato and Romeo Lavia drop to the bench. The other new face in the side from last weekend’s draw with Hull City is Maxence Lacroix, while Henderson's selection means he makes his Blues debut against the club he represented last season. The bench includes 16-year-old Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli for the first time in a competitive game. news.title: Key talking points from Sonia Bompastor's pre-Birmingham City press conference
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特在伯明翰城赛前新闻发布会上的主要谈话要点
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor faced the media at Cobham ahead of our Women's Super League clash with Birmingham City at Stamford Bridge, and here are the standout talking points from her press conference After a resounding 5-0 victory against Manchester United last Sunday, the head coach discussed the importance of a killer mindset, the strengths of our next opponents and her enjoyment of her role as Chelsea head coach. She also went into detail on the role of right wing-back Ellie Carpenter in the side and discussed what will be her 200th game as a manager on Saturday. 'I'm still having a great experience at Chelsea, and I'm loving every moment because I'm really passionate. 'After 200 games as a manager, I feel even more confident and more mature in terms of the way I manage the squad and my decisions every day. Every player and every manager comes to this league because they want to be challenged – that's also why I came here. 'I probably could have stayed longer in France and been more comfortable with winning more games, with not having maybe as much opposition, but that's not who I am. I want to be challenged. I want to find solutions when it's difficult, and this league is really good for that reason.' 'I've been talking a lot about mentality and mindsets. I think every team in this league has a lot of quality, really good individuals, but what sometimes makes the difference is your mentality and your mindset coming into training sessions every day and coming into the games. 'This mentality to want to hurt the team when you are playing against them makes the difference between having good players and the best players in the world. The main difference between our first game and the second was the intensity and the mindset we played with in the Man United game; I think it was quite clear. 'Coaching that is not always easy, but that's my job, and we are focusing on that a lot because I think we have enough quality in this team, so it's making sure we always bring the intensity into our games, but also the right mindset.' 'I think Ellie is a player who can play different positions in different systems. Right now, we are using her more as a right wing-back. That position gives her maybe a little bit more freedom because she knows she has players behind her who are defending, and we are keeping a better balance in the team. 'A lot of spaces were in that corridor during the last two games we played in, so that's why we were attacking that side. She has the ability to hurt teams in the space in behind the back line. 'She's quick, her ability with the ball is also improving a lot, and she's able to have really good crosses. She's able to score great goals when she comes into that position in the box. So that's something we are trying to use a lot because it's working, but we also have the opportunity to do that on the left side with Alyssa Thompson. 'She's also a really good profile for us to use and to, again, use the speed of them both behind the back line. So, yeah, we'll see.' 'They have the ability, with individuals and as a team, to have a lot of quality in terms of the defensive aspects, but also hurting teams in different ways. They are really well organised defensively as well. 'I watched their first two games and some of the games in preseason for Birmingham, and they have a lot of quality. Even if they lost their first game, the performances were good. So we need to be at our best tomorrow.' 'First and foremost, when you have some injuries and players are not available, you need to have this versatility. You need to find solutions when you are a manager. 'So I think it's good for me as a coach to sometimes talk to the players about being able to play in different positions, but also in terms of tactics, trying to help them understand different positions. So you do that a lot with the young players in the academy, but also in the first team at Chelsea with the young ones. 'I think we are lucky enough to also have experienced players who can play multiple positions, and it's good, especially when you get injuries, so you can still try to manage and find the right solutions to win the game.' Don't miss our huge London derby clash against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge! Secure your seat now...
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特在斯坦福桥对阵伯明翰城的女足超级联赛之前在科巴姆接受了媒体采访，以下是她在新闻发布会上的精彩谈话要点。在上周日以 5-0 战胜曼联后，主教练讨论了杀手心态的重要性、我们下一个对手的优势以及她对切尔西主教练角色的享受。她还详细介绍了右后卫艾莉·卡彭特在球队中的角色，并讨论了周六她作为主教练的第 200 场比赛。 “我在切尔西仍然拥有美好的经历，我热爱每一刻，因为我真的充满激情。 “作为一名主教练，参加了 200 场比赛之后，我在管理球队的方式和每天的决定方面变得更加自信、更加成熟。每个球员和每个教练来到这个联盟都是因为他们想要接受挑战——这也是我来到这里的原因。 “我可能可以在法国呆更长时间，并且更愿意赢得更多比赛，而不会遇到那么多的反对，但这不是我。我想受到挑战。我想在遇到困难时找到解决方案，因此这个联盟真的很棒。” “我一直在谈论很多关于心态和心态的问题。我认为这个联盟中的每支球队都有很多优秀的球员，但有时真正重要的是你的心态以及每天训练和比赛时的心态。 “当你与球队比赛时，这种想要伤害球队的心态决定了拥有优秀球员和世界上最好球员之间的区别。我们的第一场比赛和第二场比赛的主要区别在于我们在对阵曼联的比赛中的强度和心态；我想这已经很清楚了。 “教练并不总是那么容易，但这是我的工作，我们非常关注这一点，因为我认为我们这支球队有足够的素质，所以它确保我们始终将强度带入我们的比赛，但也有正确的心态。” “我认为埃莉是一位可以在不同体系中打不同位置的球员。现在，我们更多地使用她作为右翼后卫。这个位置可能给了她更多的自由，因为她知道她身后有防守的球员，而我们在球队中保持了更好的平衡。 “在我们参加的最后两场比赛中，走廊里有很多空间，所以这就是我们攻击那一侧的原因。她有能力在后防线的空间内伤害球队。 “她速度很快，控球能力也有了很大提高，而且她能够传出非常好的传中。当她进入禁区的那个位置时，她能够打进精彩的进球。所以这是我们经常尝试使用的东西，因为它很有效，但我们也有机会在左边与艾莉莎·汤普森一起做到这一点。 “她对我们来说也是一个非常好的侧身，可以再次利用她们在后线的速度。所以，是的，我们拭目以待。 “无论是个人还是团队，他们都有能力在防守方面表现出色，但也会以不同的方式伤害球队。他们的防守也组织得很好。 “我观看了他们的前两场比赛以及伯明翰季前赛的一些比赛，他们的实力很高。尽管第一场比赛他们输了，但他们的表现还是不错的。所以明天我们需要保持最佳状态。” “首先也是最重要的，当你受伤并且球员无法上场时，你需要具备这种多功能性。当你是管理者时，你需要找到解决方案。 “所以我认为作为一名教练，有时与球员谈论能够踢不同的位置以及战术方面的事情对我来说是有好处的，试图帮助他们理解不同的位置。所以你在青训营里经常对年轻球员这样做，而且在切尔西一线队也对年轻球员这样做。 “我认为我们很幸运，拥有经验丰富的球员，可以打多个位置，这很好，特别是当你受伤的时候，所以你仍然可以尝试管理并找到正确的解决方案来赢得比赛。”不要错过我们在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的伦敦德比大战！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.title: Premier League ticket news: Manchester United at home
news.title_zh: 英超联赛门票新闻：曼联主场
news.body_en: The ticket selling information has been announced for our final fixture of next month. Chelsea host Manchester United in a Premier League encounter on Saturday 31 October with a 12:30pm kick-off at Stamford Bridge. Home tickets for members for men’s team matches are now allocated through a new application process. For each home match, eligible members have a designated application window during which they can apply for tickets. Applications can be made individually or as a group, provided all members of the group are eligible to apply during that window. Tickets will be allocated one per person with a maximum of four per application. Please note: Loyalty points accrued so far this season will be applied to this fixture. To be successful in this ticket application window, fans will be required to have 9 loyalty points or more. Please note, applications that include anyone who does not meet the threshold will automatically be deemed to be unsuccessful. Any supporters who do not meet the loyalty point requirement will also not have access to the priority ticket exchange window. A list of all the loyalty points that could be accrued so far this season is available at the bottom of this page. Ticket application window opens – Monday 21 September 12pm Ticket application window closes – Thursday 24 September 12pm The ticket application window will be open for True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue and Junior Blue members. As part of the verification process, a pre-authorisation charge £0.01 will be applied to validate your payment card. No money will be taken at this stage, and the hold will be removed by your provider. Tickets for this match are priced at Category AA. Please click here for match ticket prices Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event. Eligible members can submit their application through the official ticketing portal at any time during the window, supporters must ensure they are logged in to successfully apply. Applying earlier does not increase the likelihood of success, giving supporters greater flexibility to apply at a time that suits them. As part of the new ticket sales process, members who are eligible for concession-rate tickets are automatically assigned their price class. To ensure you are receiving the correct ticket, please take the time to check the date of birth on your account is accurate. You will only be allocated tickets in your selected areas unless you choose to be considered for other available options. If you only wish to be entered for tickets in one area of the stadium, please leave the second option blank. Please read the ticket application information carefully before submitting your application. Successful and unsuccessful applications will be notified by email within four working days of the ticket application window closing date. Successful applications will be charged to their payment card approximately at this time. Supporters are not able to use account credit for ticket application window purchases. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend with and sit next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over. Members and season ticket holders can purchase Westview tickets for Premier League home games via the Chelsea FC Official Ticketing Portal. A maximum of four tickets can be bought per person, and only the ticket purchaser is required to be a member or season ticket holder. You are not required to be a member or season ticket holder to purchase non-Westview Club Chelsea packages. Club Chelsea tickets are non-refundable unless the match is cancelled, postponed, or moved more than 48 hours either side of the scheduled fixture date. All Club Chelsea ticket purchases are subject to Club Chelsea terms and conditions. For any further Westview enquiries, please email clubchelsea@chelseafc.com. Loyalty points will now only be awarded for attendance at men’s first-team home matches and no longer accrued for purchasing tickets. Points will be added to eligible accounts following each game, provided the ticket has been scanned at the turnstile. This means that supporters purchasing tickets on the ticket exchange, or receiving tickets via ticket forwarding, will now receive loyalty points for attending matches. Supporters will receive one loyalty point for attending this match. Points will be applied after the fixture has been played. Members can still purchase general admission tickets if available in line with the General Admission Policy. Supporters who require accessible tickets can apply through the accessible ticket application window. Timings are below: Accessible ticket application window opens - Monday 21 September 12pm Accessible ticket application window closes – Thursday 24 September 12pm Supporters, if they are able to do so, can call our Access Team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers) for any questions or if they need further information. Personal assistant tickets can be submitted during this ticket application window. Supporters can apply for car parking by clicking here from Thursday 1 October. You are required to display your Blue Badge while parked at Stamford Bridge. In addition to season ticket holders, True Blue+, True Blue and CFC Blue members now have the option to list tickets on the ticket exchange if they are unable to attend a home match. Supporters can access the ticket exchange through the official ticketing portal. The sales information on the buy tickets pagewill be updated once the ticket exchange is open. The ticket exchange will close three hours before kick-off, unless stated otherwise. Those unsuccessful in the ticket application window, who met the loyalty points criteria for this fixture, will have a ticket exchange priority period. These supporters will be notified via email that the priority window is open. A further announcement will be made on the buy tickets page to confirm when the ticket exchange is open to all members. The all on-sale dates page available by clicking here will also be updated. Once open, season ticket holders and members can send and receive tickets up until three hours before kick-off. news.body_en: There has been an update on the loyalty points required by members wishing to apply for tickets for next month’s London derby. Our Premier League encounter with Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge kicks off at 5.30pm on Saturday 24 October. Home tickets for members for men’s team matches are now allocated through a new application process. For each home match, eligible members have a designated application window during which they can apply for tickets. Applications can be made individually or as a group, provided all members of the group are eligible to apply during that window. Tickets will be allocated one per person with a maximum of four per application. Please note: Loyalty points accrued so far this season will be applied to this fixture. To be successful in this ticket application window, fans will be required to have 8 loyalty points or more. Please note, applications that include anyone who does not meet the threshold will automatically be deemed to be unsuccessful. Any supporters who do not meet the loyalty point requirement will also not have access to the priority ticket exchange window. A list of all the loyalty points that could be accrued so far this season is available at the bottom of this page. The ticket application window has been extended and will now close on Monday 21 September at 9am, giving fans the opportunity to amend their application before the new deadline closes. Click for an information guide if you are unsure how to amend or withdraw your ticket application The ticket application window is open for True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue and Junior Blue members. As part of the verification process, a pre-authorisation charge £0.01 will be applied to validate your payment card. No money will be taken at this stage, and the hold will be removed by your provider. Tickets for this match are priced at Category AA. Please click here for match ticket prices Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event. Eligible members can submit their application through the official ticketing portal at any time during the window, supporters must ensure they are logged in to successfully apply. Applying earlier does not increase the likelihood of success, giving supporters greater flexibility to apply at a time that suits them. As part of the new ticket sales process, members who are eligible for concession-rate tickets are automatically assigned their price class. To ensure you are receiving the correct ticket, please take the time to check the date of birth on your account is accurate. You will only be allocated tickets in your selected areas unless you choose to be considered for other available options. If you only wish to be entered for tickets in one area of the stadium, please leave the second option blank. Please read the ticket application information carefully before submitting your application. Successful and unsuccessful applications will be notified by email within four working days of the ticket application window closing date. Successful applications will be charged to their payment card approximately at this time. Supporters are not able to use account credit for ticket application window purchases. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend with and sit next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over. Members and season ticket holders can purchase Westview tickets for Premier League home games via the Chelsea FC Official Ticketing Portal. A maximum of four tickets can be bought per person, and only the ticket purchaser is required to be a member or season ticket holder. You are not required to be a member or season ticket holder to purchase non-Westview Club Chelsea packages. Club Chelsea tickets are non-refundable unless the match is cancelled, postponed, or moved more than 48 hours either side of the scheduled fixture date. All Club Chelsea ticket purchases are subject to Club Chelsea terms and conditions. For any further Westview enquiries, please email clubchelsea@chelseafc.com. Loyalty points will now only be awarded for attendance at men’s first-team home matches and no longer accrued for purchasing tickets. Points will be added to eligible accounts following each game, provided the ticket has been scanned at the turnstile. This means that supporters purchasing tickets on the ticket exchange, or receiving tickets via ticket forwarding, will now receive loyalty points for attending matches. Supporters will receive one loyalty point for attending this match. Points will be applied after the fixture has been played. Members can still purchase general admission tickets if available in line with the General Admission Policy. Supporters who require accessible tickets can apply through the accessible ticket application window. Timings are below: Accessible ticket application window closes – Monday 21 September at 9am Supporters, if they are able to do so, can call our Access Team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers) for any questions or if they need further information. Personal assistant tickets can be submitted during this ticket application window. Supporters can apply for car parking by clicking here from Thursday 24 September. You are required to display your Blue Badge while parked at Stamford Bridge. In addition to season ticket holders, True Blue+, True Blue and CFC Blue members now have the option to list tickets on the ticket exchange if they are unable to attend a home match. Supporters can access the ticket exchange through the official ticketing portal. The ticket exchange is now open to season ticket holders wishing to list their tickets. The ticket exchange will close three hours before kick-off, unless stated otherwise. Those unsuccessful in the ticket application window, who met the loyalty points criteria for this fixture, will have a ticket exchange priority period. These supporters will be notified via email that the priority window is open. A further announcement will be made on the buy tickets page to confirm when the ticket exchange is open to all members. The all on-sale dates page available by clicking here will also be updated. Once open, season ticket holders and members can send and receive tickets up until three hours before kick-off. Please note that those who have forwarded their ticket will not be able to list their ticket on the ticket exchange. news.title: Sonia Bompastor delivers positive injury update on key trio
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 公布了关键三人组的积极伤病情况
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has confirmed that Nathalie Bjorn, Naomi Girma and Melvine Malard will all be available for selection when we take on Birmingham City at Stamford Bridge. Chelsea host the newly-promoted side tomorrow afternoon, with kick off scheduled for 12.45pm, and Bompastor will have extra resources to call upon. Bjorn was named on the substitutes' bench for our 5-0 win against Manchester United last weekend, but did not feature. Meanwhile, Girma and Malard were not in the squad. However, Bompastor says each of the trio is in contention to feature this time around. 'Nay is back in the group and will be with the group tomorrow for the game,' confirmed the Blues boss. 'Nat Bjorn is back, and Melvine Malard is also back in the squad. 'It's really important, really good and positive, especially as we are going to enter a period of three games in a week and six games in the next two weeks. 'It's really important to have as many players available as possible because I think if you want to maintain the intensity, you need to be able to rotate and have some fresh legs coming into every game.' Mayra Ramirez has also been absent from the squad in recent weeks and Bompastor gave an update on her availability too. 'Mayra is back in Colombia for personal reasons,' Bompastor explained. 'The club is supporting her in the best way possible and we are hoping to see her back with the squad and with the team soon.'
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特确认，当我们在斯坦福桥迎战伯明翰城时，纳塔莉·比约恩、娜奥米·吉尔玛和梅尔文·马拉德都将可供选择。切尔西明天下午将迎战升班马，开球时间定于中午 12 点 45 分，邦帕斯托将拥有额外的资源可供调用。上周末我们5-0战胜曼联的比赛中，比约恩被列入替补席，但他没有出场。与此同时，吉尔玛和马拉德并不在球队中。然而，邦帕斯特表示，这一次三人组都在争夺出场机会。蓝军主帅证实，“奈伊已经回到了球队，并将与球队一起参加明天的比赛。”纳特·比约恩回来了，梅尔文·马拉德也回到了球队。 “这真的很重要，真的很好，很积极，特别是因为我们将进入一周三场比赛和接下来两周六场比赛的时期。 “拥有尽可能多的球员非常重要，因为我认为如果你想保持强度，你需要能够轮换并在每场比赛中都有一些新鲜的球员。”最近几周，梅拉·拉米雷斯也缺席了球队，邦帕斯特也更新了她的可用情况。 “梅拉出于个人原因回到了哥伦比亚，”邦帕斯特解释道。 “俱乐部正在以最好的方式支持她，我们希望看到她很快回到球队和球队中。”

news.title: Make it a Blue Day when CFCW take on Arsenal!

news.body_en: Stamford Bridge will host a blockbuster at the end of this month when Chelsea Women go up against the Gunners, and there are plenty of opportunities for Blues fans to play your part. The game between the two most successful clubs in the WSL era, the biggest London derby in women’s football, takes place at 4.30pm on Sunday 27 September, during the break for international fixtures for the men’s team. - Buy your tickets for the big match here We are declaring it a Blue Day and to celebrate the occasion and show your support for the team, those at the Bridge can: Head to the Fan Zone at the Tea Bar for blue face painting, fun activities and live music. news.title: Alonso on Welbeck’s smooth adaptation and Henderson value
news.title_zh: 阿隆索谈维尔贝克的顺利适应和亨德森的价值
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has praised Danny Welbeck's immediate impact at Chelsea and highlighted the vital experience Jordan Henderson has brought to the Blues squad ahead of today’s Premier League clash at Brentford. Welbeck arrived at Stamford Bridge this summer from Brighton and Hove Albion to reinforce our frontline and add expertise from his many years playing in the Premier League. It is apparent from the words of his Chelsea team-mates that the 35-year-old has integrated seamlessly into the group off the pitch. On it, Welbeck has shown encouraging signs in his early appearances, which have included goals in both of our Carabao Cup fixtures so far. There is the possibility of Welbeck making his full Premier League debut for the Blues this evening at the Gtech Stadium. That is a decision for Alonso to make, but the Spaniard has been pleased with the striker's smooth adjustment to life at the Bridge ‘He has adapted very well,’ said Alonso. ‘There was no doubt about that. He has connected very well with the team. He knows what he has to do. ‘He has started a couple of games in the Carabao Cup, and the other day he was close to scoring one goal, so yeah, we are happy with Danny.’ With a demanding fixture list across multiple competitions, Alonso reiterated that every Chelsea player, including Welbeck, must remain prepared to step up when called upon. ‘It's about having a complete squad and about knowing that everyone is ready to play whenever they’re needed,’ he added. ‘You have to be ready. This is professional football, and you need to know when you are in, you need to perform.’ Our third consecutive London away game this season takes us to Henderson's previous home. The midfielder is yet to make his Blues bow following the arm injury he suffered at this summer’s World Cup, but Alonso has not ruled out the possibility of the 36-year-old featuring against his former club tonight. And our manager provided background on the reasons behind Henderson's signing in the summer: chiefly his ability to elevate standards on and off the ball. ‘We analysed it and we wanted to have a good balance between maturity, between experience, between talent, between energy. We have taken a step forward, and we have improved, I think, in that part. ‘Jordan has played an important role being a midfielder, with the impact that he can have with other players, but he has this quality and this personality to improve and to help other players as well. ‘We wanted to have a good balance and people who could add value for what they do and what could improve the other ones, and Jordan does it very well.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索赞扬了丹尼·维尔贝克对切尔西的直接影响，并强调了乔丹·亨德森在今天布伦特福德的英超比赛之前为蓝军队带来的重要经验。维尔贝克今年夏天从布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩来到斯坦福桥，以加强我们的锋线并补充他在英超联赛中多年踢球的专业知识。从切尔西队友的话语中可以明显看出，这位35岁的球员在场外已经无缝地融入了球队。在这方面，维尔贝克在他的早期出场中表现出了令人鼓舞的迹象，其中包括迄今为止我们在卡拉宝杯的两场比赛中的进球。维尔贝克有可能今晚在 Gtech 体育场完成他为蓝军完成的英超首秀。这是阿隆索要做的决定，但西班牙人对前锋顺利适应蓝桥生活感到满意。“他适应得很好，”阿隆索说。 ” “这一点毫无疑问。他与球队的联系非常好。他知道他必须做什么。 “他在卡拉宝杯中首发了几场比赛，有一天他差点就打进一球，所以是的，我们对丹尼感到满意。”由于多场比赛的赛程要求很高，阿隆索重申，包括维尔贝克在内的每一位切尔西球员都必须做好准备，在需要时挺身而出。 “这是关于拥有一支完整的球队，并且知道每个人都已经准备好在需要时参加比赛，”他补充道。 ‘你必须做好准备。这是职业足球，你需要知道什么时候你在场，你需要表现。” 本赛季我们连续第三次在伦敦客场比赛，我们将前往亨德森之前的主场。这位中场球员在今年夏天的世界杯上手臂受伤后，尚未代表蓝军出场，但阿隆索并未排除这位36岁的球员今晚在对阵老东家的比赛中出场的可能性。我们的经理提供了亨德森夏季签约原因的背景：主要是他提高有球和无球水平的能力。 “我们对其进行了分析，我们希望在成熟度、经验、天赋和精力之间取得良好的平衡。我们已经向前迈出了一步，我认为我们在这方面已经有所进步。 “乔丹作为一名中场球员发挥了重要作用，他可以对其他球员产生影响，但他也有这种品质和个性来提高并帮助其他球员。 “我们希望有一个良好的平衡，人们可以为自己所做的事情增加价值，也可以改进其他人，而乔丹在这方面做得很好。”

news.title: Romeo Lavia on feeling free, taking responsibility and changing his Chelsea narrative
news.title_zh: 罗密欧·拉维亚谈自由、承担责任和改变他的切尔西叙事
news.body_en: Romeo Lavia has thanked his team-mates and the Chelsea coaching staff for helping him overcome adversity and start this season strongly, as he looks to push himself to new levels on the pitch. The midfielder's Chelsea career, by his own admission, has been stop-start. Injuries have made it difficult for the Belgian to find his rhythm at Stamford Bridge, although when fully fit, supporters have seen the qualities he brings to the side. This season, Lavia has started our opening four Premier League fixtures under Xabi Alonso. He has impressed, looked sharp, and helped cover the absence of Moises Caicedo – the Ecuadorian's only minutes this term came as a second-half substitute against Brighton and Hove Albion. It's no surprise, then, that Lavia is feeling confident and has a renewed sense of purpose at Chelsea. He is determined to show everyone what he is truly capable of. ‘This season feels different because I'm in a different…let’s say mindset or space of mind,’ explained Lavia. ‘We've done a lot of work over the summer with all the people at the club to make sure that we could get everything that's happened before behind me. So far it's going well. I'm very happy and long may it continue. ‘To show up under the lights on the weekend is the last part of the puzzle; there is so much that goes on behind the scenes. It's the constant analysing of all the aspects that you want to tick off before being ready to play on the weekend. It's a big process, but we're doing well at the moment. ‘I've learned that you can always go further than you think you can. You can always push your limits, especially when you feel like everything is going against you. It's always so easy to just think about giving up, or think that no matter what you do, it's only going to go back to the same point where you started. ‘Luckily, with the help of my team-mates, the staff, everyone at the club and outside, the people close to me, we've been able to create a sort of bubble where you just concentrate on what you can control, and then everything will come out on top. ‘It's been a little bit stop-start since I've joined, so it's a bit frustrating, but the reason why I'm so excited about what's to come is that, whether it's in training or games, I feel the love from my team-mates. ‘I feel like they trust in me, which is then giving me the confidence to go and express myself without thinking about what's happened. That's something that really helps me.’ That love was evident when Lavia scored his first Chelsea goal earlier this season. He found the net in our 4-3 win over Brighton & Hove Albion at Stamford Bridge, sparking emotional celebrations as the rest of the players rushed to congratulate him in front of the home fans. ‘To be honest, when it first went in, I didn't really believe it because it's just been so long,’ the 22-year-old admits. ‘I had kind of lost that feeling of scoring, but thinking back, it was an amazing feeling. Then, straight away, all my team-mates grabbed me. So it was a very good moment to experience. ‘It was just a moment where I felt free, where it feels like all the work that you're putting in, you're getting the reward for it. It was a very good but very emotional moment at the same time, so I wanted to express it as much as possible with the fans. I really loved it. ‘Especially because I wanted to change the narrative. My first Premier League goal was against Chelsea, so I always felt like it was a bit strange. 'Then I've seen all my team-mates score at Stamford Bridge and the atmosphere that it would create, so I was waiting for it to be my turn. When it happened, I was just very happy and excited.’ Of course, it is for far more than that goal that his team-mates, the supporters and Alonso are so pleased to see Lavia back in the Chelsea midfield, with the quality of his performances this season making it seem like he has never been missing. If he was feeling any pressure to make up for lost time, he certainly hasn’t shown it. ‘Responsibility is something that has always been part of my game as well, to take responsibility and have some character,’ Romeo added. ‘I really like being in that position and also being at this club, having this responsibility. It's not even pressure; it's just like a privilege. So I'm actually living the dream. It's just like: “Okay, this is what you've been playing and training all these years for, so just go and enjoy it.”’
news.body_zh: 罗密欧·拉维亚感谢他的队友和切尔西教练组帮助他克服逆境并强势开启本赛季，因为他希望在球场上将自己推向新的水平。这位中场球员自己承认，他在切尔西的职业生涯是断断续续的。伤病让比利时人很难在斯坦福桥找到自己的节奏，尽管在完全康复后，球迷们已经看到了他为球队带来的品质。本赛季，拉维亚在哈维·阿隆索的带领下首发了四场英超联赛。他给人留下了深刻的印象，看起来很敏锐，并帮助弥补了莫伊塞斯·凯塞多的缺席——厄瓜多尔人本赛季唯一的上场时间是在对阵布莱顿和霍夫·阿尔比恩的下半场替补出场。因此，拉维亚感到自信并且在切尔西有了新的目标感也就不足为奇了。他决心向所有人展示他真正的能力。 “这个赛季感觉不同，因为我处于不同的……比如说心态或思维空间，”拉维亚解释道。 `整个夏天我们与俱乐部的所有人一起做了很多工作，以确保我们能够把之前发生的一切都抛在脑后。到目前为止一切进展顺利。我很高兴，希望这种情况能够持续下去。 “周末出现在灯光下是这个难题的最后一部分；幕后发生了很多事情。这是在准备周末比赛之前对您想要勾选的所有方面进行不断的分析。这是一个很大的过程，但我们目前做得很好。 “我了解到，你总是可以比你想象的走得更远。你总是可以突破自己的极限，尤其是当你觉得一切都对你不利时。人们总是很容易想到放弃，或者认为无论你做什么，都只会回到你开始的地方。 “幸运的是，在我的队友、工作人员、俱乐部内外的每个人以及我身边的人的帮助下，我们能够创造一种泡沫，让你专注于你能控制的事情，然后一切都会水到渠成。 “自从我加入以来，情况有点停顿，所以有点令人沮丧，但我对即将发生的事情如此兴奋的原因是，无论是在训练还是比赛中，我都能感受到队友们的爱。 “我觉得他们信任我，这让我有信心去表达自己，而不用考虑发生了什么。这对我确实有帮助。”当拉维亚在本赛季早些时候攻入他在切尔西的第一个进球时，这种爱就显而易见了。他在斯坦福桥4-3战胜布莱顿的比赛中攻入进球，引发了激动人心的庆祝活动，其他球员也纷纷在主场球迷面前向他表示祝贺。这位 22 岁的年轻人承认，说实话，当它第一次进入时，我真的不太相信，因为已经过去了太久了。 “我有点失去了进球的感觉，但回想起来，那是一种奇妙的感觉。然后，我所有的队友立刻抓住了我。所以这是一个非常好的体验时刻。 “那一刻我感到自由，感觉你付出的所有努力都得到了回报。这是一个非常美好但又非常激动人心的时刻，所以我想尽可能多地向粉丝们表达这一点。我真的很喜欢它。 “特别是因为我想改变叙述方式。我的第一个英超进球是对阵切尔西的，所以我总觉得这有点奇怪。 “然后我看到了我所有的队友在斯坦福桥进球以及它所营造的氛围，所以我正在等待轮到我的机会。当这一切发生时，我感到非常高兴和兴奋。”当然，他的队友、球迷和阿隆索如此高兴看到拉维亚回到切尔西中场，远不止这个进球，他本赛季的表现让他看起来从未缺席过。如果他感到有任何压力来弥补失去的时间，他肯定没有表现出来。 “责任也一直是我比赛的一部分，承担责任并具有一定的性格，”罗密欧补充道。 “我真的很喜欢担任这个职位，也很喜欢在这个俱乐部，承担这个责任。这甚至不是压力；而是压力。这就像一种特权。所以我实际上正在实现梦想。就像：“好吧，这就是你这些年来一直在打球和训练的目的，所以去享受它吧。”

news.title: Chelsea FC transforms community football pitch in Ecuador
news.title_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部改造厄瓜多尔社区足球场
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club has completed the renovation of a community pitch in Guayaquil, Ecuador, as part of our global Can’t Tame Us campaign for the 2026/27 third kit launch, creating a renewed space for football, connection and community in one of the city’s most densely populated neighbourhoods. Located in Guasmo Norte, the futsal pitch is more than a place to play. Set among the homes and everyday life of the neighbourhood, it provides a shared outdoor space where children can kick a ball around, friends can compete, families can watch from the sidelines and neighbours can stop to talk. The renovation gives the community a refreshed place to come together through a shared love of sport, while helping to make football more accessible to the next generation. Click to shop the third kit now Ecuador is the country that gave us Moises Caicedo, the winner of our Men’s Player of the Year for the 2024/25 season, and Kendry Paez who has recently returned from a loan to join our Cobham Next Gen squad. Indeed, Guayaquil is Paez’s home city. The official opening of the pitch took place yesterday, with Ecuadorian singer Javier Neira, known for La Tri, in attendance, performing three songs. Influencers including Anthony Lencina, Camilo Balladares, Francisco Molestina, Israel Vera and Santiago Morales alongside members of the Chelsea family and local residents watched the celebrations as the renewed pitch was unveiled. The Guayaquil renovation is the third community facility to be refurbished this summer as part of Can’t Tame Us, with football’s generational appeal being used to bring communities together and encourage greater participation in the sport. The project follows the launch of facilities in São Paulo and in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, with thousands of fans visiting and using the renewed pitches. Across all three locations, the aim is simple: to create spaces where football can be played, shared and passed from one generation to the next; using the power of the game to bring people together and help communities thrive. Scott Fenton, Brand director at Chelsea FC, said: ‘Ecuador has a special connection with Chelsea and has produced incredible players such as Moises Caicedo, and fantastic talents like Kendry Paez. We want to build on that connection by inspiring and empowering future generations of fans and young footballers, giving them the opportunity to discover their potential, develop their skills and dream big. This community space is an important part of that commitment.’
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部已经完成了厄瓜多尔瓜亚基尔社区球场的翻新工程，这是我们为 2026/27 年第三套球衣发布而推出的全球“不能驯服我们”活动的一部分，为该市人口最稠密的社区之一创造了一个全新的足球、联系和社区空间。五人制足球场位于瓜斯莫北 (Guasmo Norte)，它不仅仅是一个比赛场所。它坐落在社区的家庭和日常生活中，提供了一个共享的户外空间，孩子们可以在这里踢球，朋友可以比赛，家人可以在场边观看，邻居可以停下来交谈。此次翻修为社区提供了一个焕然一新的场所，让他们通过对体育的共同热爱聚集在一起，同时有助于让下一代更容易接触到足球。点击立即购买第三套球衣 厄瓜多尔为我们提供了 2024/25 赛季年度最佳男子球员得主莫伊塞斯·凯塞多 (Moises Caicedo)，以及最近从租借归来加入我们的科巴姆下一代球队的肯德利·帕兹 (Kendry Paez)。事实上，瓜亚基尔是帕埃斯的家乡。昨天，球场正式开幕，因《La Tri》而闻名的厄瓜多尔歌手哈维尔·内拉出席并演唱了三首歌。包括安东尼·伦西纳、卡米洛·巴拉达雷斯、弗朗西斯科·莫莱斯蒂纳、以色列·维拉和圣地亚哥·莫拉莱斯在内的影响力人士以及切尔西家族成员和当地居民观看了新球场揭幕仪式的庆祝活动。瓜亚基尔翻修工程是今年夏天翻新的第三个社区设施，是“不能驯服我们”项目的一部分，利用足球的代际吸引力将社区聚集在一起，鼓励更多人参与这项运动。该项目是在巴西圣保罗和里约热内卢的设施启动后推出的，成千上万的球迷参观并使用了更新后的球场。这三个地点的目标都很简单：创造可以踢球、分享足球并代代相传的空间；利用游戏的力量将人们聚集在一起并帮助社区蓬勃发展。切尔西足球俱乐部品牌总监斯科特·芬顿表示：“厄瓜多尔与切尔西有着特殊的联系，并培养了像莫伊塞斯·凯塞多这样令人难以置信的球员，以及像肯德利·帕埃斯这样的出色人才。我们希望通过激励和赋权下一代球迷和年轻足球运动员来建立这种联系，让他们有机会发现自己的潜力，发展他们的技能并实现远大的梦想。这个社区空间是这一承诺的重要组成部分。

news.title: Three Women’s Super League matches at the Bridge on sale next week
news.title_zh: 下周在大桥举行的三场女足超级联赛比赛将发售
news.body_en: With the Barclays WSL season now properly underway, three more of this season’s games to be played at Stamford Bridge will have their tickets go on sale on Monday. Sonia Bompastor’s side recorded their first win in this season’s competition last weekend and they did so in style, with a 5-0 win at Manchester United. Tomorrow the Blues return to the Bridge to play Birmingham (tickets are available here) and further on the horizon are three home fixtures in November and December. All are yet to have their dates and kick-off times confirmed but over the weekend of 7 and 8 November we welcome Everton, and the following weekend we take on the team we are aiming to reclaim the league crown from, Manchester City. Those are followed by a derby against London City Lionesses on the weekend of 12/13 December. Ticket sales for these matches will be as follows (supporters can purchase up to 20 tickets per transaction): For all three matches, early-bird tickets will be on sale from 2pm on Monday 21 September. For all three matches, general sale tickets will be on sale from 2pm on Monday 28 September. For the match versus Everton, last chance to buy tickets will be on sale from 12pm on Wednesday 4 November. For the match versus Manchester City, last chance to buy tickets will be on sale from 12pm on Wednesday 11 November. For the match versus London City Lionesses, last chance to buy tickets will be on sale from 12pm on Wednesday 9 December. Supporters who hold a Bridge Pass will not need to purchase tickets for the Manchester City and London City Lionesses games as these fixture are covered in the pass. Tickets will be sold online only and are for Chelsea supporters only. They are initially available to purchase in the entirety of the lower bowl except for the Everton game where they are initially available to purchase in the West lower and Shed lower. Premium tickets are available to purchase by selecting the Pitch View Lounge in blocks 1 and 2 of the Shed Lower. Alcoholic drinks purchased in the stadium will be allowed in all areas of the stadium except the alcohol-free stands in blocks 1 and 2 of the West Lower. Tickets for the Man City and London City Lionesses matches are priced at Category A. For the Everton match they are Category B. Click here for match ticket prices Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend with, and sit next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over. Supporters who require accessible tickets can submit an application form available by clicking here during the selling period. Alternatively, you can call our Access Team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers) to reserve tickets and request further information. Personal assistant tickets can only be allocated using this process. Supporters can click here to apply for car parking from 10am on Tuesday 17 October (Everton game), 10am on Tuesday 20 October (Man City game), and 10am on Tuesday 17 November (London City Lionesses). You are required to display your Blue Badge while parked at Stamford Bridge. Season ticket holders will be able to list their tickets for select games throughout the season, and the sales information on the Buy Tickets page will be updated if the ticket exchange opens. Supporters can receive tickets up until three hours before kick-off. Please note that those who have forwarded their ticket will not be able to list their ticket on the ticket exchange. Match and ticket on-sale dates are subject to change. All ticket sales are subject to availability. Please check the website for the latest information.
news.body_zh: 随着巴克莱 WSL 赛季的顺利进行，本赛季在斯坦福桥举行的另外三场比赛的门票将于周一开始发售。索尼娅·邦帕斯托的球队上周末以 5-0 战胜曼联，取得了本赛季的首场胜利。明天蓝军将返回大桥迎战伯明翰（门票可在此处购买），接下来还有 11 月和 12 月的三场主场比赛。所有比赛的日期和开球时间都尚未确定，但在 11 月 7 日至 8 日的周末，我们将迎来埃弗顿，下周末我们将迎战我们的目标是从曼城手中夺回联赛冠军。随后，12 月 12 日至 13 日周末将与伦敦城狮队进行德比战。这些比赛的门票销售情况如下（支持者每次交易最多可购买 20 张门票）： 对于所有三场比赛，早鸟票将于 9 月 21 日星期一下午 2 点开始发售。所有三场比赛的普通门票将于 9 月 28 日星期一下午 2 点开始发售。对于对阵埃弗顿的比赛，最后一次购票机会将于 11 月 4 日星期三中午 12 点开始发售。对于对阵曼城的比赛，最后一次购票机会将于 11 月 11 日星期三中午 12 点开始发售。对于与 London City Lioness 的比赛，最后一次购票机会将于 12 月 9 日星期三中午 12 点开始发售。持有桥牌通行证的支持者无需购买曼城队和伦敦城狮队比赛的门票，因为这些比赛都包含在通票内。门票仅在网上出售，且仅限切尔西球迷。它们最初可以在整个下碗区购买，除了埃弗顿的比赛，它们最初可以在西下区和谢德下区购买。高级门票可通过选择位于 Shed Lower 1 号和 2 号区块的 Pitch View Lounge 购买。除西下区 1 号和 2 号区域的无酒精饮料看台外，体育场内的所有区域均允许购买在体育场内购买的酒精饮料。曼城和伦敦城狮队比赛的门票价格为 A 类。埃弗顿比赛的门票价格为 B 类。点击此处查看比赛门票价格 门票将在比赛开始前显示在切尔西官方应用程序上。所有 16 岁以下的人员都必须与 18 岁或以上的人员一起参加，并坐在其旁边。需要无障碍门票的支持者可以在销售期间点击此处提交申请表。或者，您可以致电 0371 811 2012 或 0044 207 915 1950（国际电话）联系我们的访问团队预订门票并索取更多信息。个人助理门票只能使用此流程分配。支持者可以点击此处申请停车位，时间为 10 月 17 日星期二上午 10 点（埃弗顿比赛）、10 月 20 日星期二上午 10 点（曼城比赛）和 11 月 17 日星期二上午 10 点（伦敦城狮队比赛）。您在斯坦福桥停车时需要出示您的蓝色徽章。季票持有者将能够列出整个赛季精选比赛的门票，如果门票交换开放，“购买门票”页面上的销售信息将会更新。支持者最晚可以在开球前三小时收到门票。请注意，已转发门票的人将无法在票务兑换处列出其门票。比赛和门票发售日期可能会发生变化。所有门票销售均视供应情况而定。请查看网站以获取最新信息。

news.title: Chelsea Under-18s vs Bournemouth: How to watch it live
news.title_zh: 切尔西 18 岁以下青年队对阵伯恩茅斯：如何观看直播

Jashayde Greenwood hit a brace, alongside goals by Andrew Pennie and Heze Grimwade, as the young Blues continued our strong start to the season with an emphatic 5-1 win away at Brighton & Hove Albion last time out. We will now be looking to carry that high-scoring form back to home soil, after netting 20 goals across our opening five league games. news.body_zh: 切尔西 18 岁以下青年队希望在伯恩茅斯造访科巴姆时取得连胜，CFC+ 订阅者可以在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上观看比赛直播。贾谢德·格林伍德梅开二度，安德鲁·彭尼和赫泽·格里姆韦德也各进一球，年轻的蓝军在上一场客场5-1大胜布莱顿的比赛中延续了本赛季的强势开局。在前五场联赛中攻入 20 个进球后，我们现在希望将这种高分状态带回主场。您可以通过以下方式现场观看 18 岁以下英超联赛对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛...比赛将于 9 月 19 日星期六上午 11 点（英国时间）在科巴姆开赛。所有 CFC+ 订阅者都可以在切尔西官方网站和切尔西官方应用程序上观看这场比赛以及切尔西本赛季 18 岁以下英超联赛的所有比赛。您可以获取有关 CFC+ 的更多详细信息并在此处注册。您可以在开赛前点击下方或通过切尔西官方网站主页和切尔西官方应用程序观看切尔西 18 岁以下青年队对阵伯恩茅斯比赛中心的直播。确保您已使用 CFC+ 订阅登录才能查看流。 9 月 20 日（星期日）上午，所有球迷均可在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上免费观看比赛的精彩片段。

news.title: FPL 2026/27: Chelsea Gameweek five
news.title_zh: FPL 2026/27：切尔西第五周比赛
news.body_en: Chelsea have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. Here, we look at which of the Blues' players are must-haves, who the best value-for-money picks are, and why Morgan Rogers (£7.7m) is Chelsea’s most popular player this week. Cole Palmer (£9.7m) continues to show consistency, picking up his fourth attacking return of the season in the entertaining 2-2 draw against Hull City in Gameweek 4. Chelsea’s attack has scored a whopping 18 goals in six matches under Xabi Alonso. Our number 10 had three shots on goal and created three chances at Stamford Bridge - no Chelsea player could better that in Gameweek 4. Averaging nearly seven points per match, Cole is currently on course to surpass his best-ever Fantasy season of 244 points in 2023/24, where he racked up 22 goals and 13 assists. No player has been transferred in by more Fantasy managers than Morgan Rogers (£7.7m) ahead of the Gameweek 5 deadline. Nearly 500,000 people have moved to bring Chelsea’s summer signing into their team; he now sits in just under 40% of squads. Rogers is the only player to register an attacking return (three goals and one assist) in each of the first four Gameweeks. Against Hull last time out, the Englishman scored and claimed a share of the bonus points. Among Blues players, Rogers ranks first for chances created (10) and passes into the penalty box (11). This demonstrates his strong assist potential ahead of Friday’s fixture against Brentford. In an Aston Villa shirt, the Chelsea number 17 netted twice against the Bees in the Premier League. Playing regularly at wing-back, Pedro Neto (£6.5m) has, in recent matches, scored the Blues’ second goal against Brighton and netted in the Carabao Cup, as well as hitting the post at Arsenal with an unfortunate first-half effort. No Blues player has registered more successful passes in the final third (50) than Neto. The Portugal international is one to watch as he is the cheapest Blues attacker in FPL to have started a league game so far. In goal, Emi Martinez (£5.0m) has picked up a save point in each of his three appearances for the club, racking up 15 saves in all. No goalkeeper has made more saves in that time. When the Blues begin keeping clean sheets, Martinez’s ceiling will be high. At £5.0m, he is cheaper than most other goalkeepers playing for top-four contending teams. As usual, Erling Haaland (£15.5m) is a key contender in the captaincy conversation ahead of Manchester City’s home fixture against Sunderland. The Norwegian has racked up some impressive underlying numbers, ranking first among all players for shots (16), shots on target (9) and big chances (7). Haaland has scored in three consecutive Gameweeks, claiming the maximum three bonus points on each occasion. The Black Cats have conceded in both their away matches this season. Elsewhere, Morgan Gibbs-White (£8.0m) is an intriguing option against Coventry City. The English midfielder has registered three attacking returns in the last three Gameweeks and takes penalties for Nottingham Forest. A home fixture against bottom-of-the-table Coventry, who conceded five goals last time out, looks primed for attacking returns. No player has created more big chances (4) so far this season than Gibbs-White, who has been bought by over 370,000 Fantasy managers.
news.body_zh: 切尔西已与 Fantasy Football Scout 合作，帮助您在 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) 赛季期间为您提供提示、技巧和建议。球探将利用他们的专业知识提供建议和比赛周技巧，这对确保您赢得迷你联赛很有用。在这里，我们来看看哪些蓝军球员是必备球员，谁是最具性价比的球员，以及为什么摩根·罗杰斯（770万英镑）是切尔西本周最受欢迎的球员。科尔·帕尔默（970万英镑）继续表现出稳定性，在第四轮比赛中以2-2战平赫尔城的比赛中完成了他本赛季的第四次进攻回归。在哈维·阿隆索的带领下，切尔西的进攻在六场比赛中攻入了惊人的18个进球。我们的 10 号球员在斯坦福桥有 3 次射门并创造了 3 次机会——在第四场比赛中，没有任何切尔西球员能比他更出色。科尔场均得分近 7 分，目前有望超越他在 2023/24 赛季拿下 244 分的最佳梦幻赛季，当时他打进 22 粒进球和 13 次助攻。在第五届比赛截止日期之前，没有比摩根·罗杰斯（770 万英镑）更多的 Fantasy 经理转会的球员了。近 50 万人已将切尔西夏季签约球员带入自己的球队；现在，他在球队中所占的比例不到 40%。罗杰斯是唯一一位在前四周比赛中每一周都有进攻回报（三粒进球和一次助攻）的球员。上一场对阵赫尔城的比赛中，英国人进球并分享了额外积分。在蓝军球员中，罗杰斯在创造机会（10）和传入禁区（11）方面排名第一。这表明了他在周五对阵布伦特福德的比赛之前强大的助攻潜力。身穿阿斯顿维拉球衣的切尔西17号球员在英超联赛对阵蜜蜂队的比赛中梅开二度。佩德罗·内托（Pedro Neto，650万英镑）经常出任边后卫，在最近的比赛中，他在对阵布莱顿的比赛中攻入了蓝军的第二个进球，并在卡拉宝杯中攻入一球，在对阵阿森纳的比赛中，他在上半场的射门不幸击中门柱。没有哪位蓝军球员在进攻三区的成功传球数（50 次）比内托还要多。这位葡萄牙国脚值得关注，因为他是迄今为止 FPL 联赛中首发身价最低的蓝军攻击手。门将埃米·马丁内斯（Emi Martinez，500万英镑）在为俱乐部出场的三场比赛中，每次都获得了一个扑救点，总共完成了15次扑救。在那段时间里，没有哪个门将做出了更多的扑救。当蓝军开始保持零失球时，马丁内斯的上限将会很高。他的身价为 500 万英镑，比为前四强球队效力的大多数其他门将都要便宜。和往常一样，埃尔林·哈兰德（1550万英镑）是曼城主场对阵桑德兰之前队长讨论中的关键竞争者。挪威人已经取得了一些令人印象深刻的基本数据，在射门（16次）、射正（9次）和绝佳机会（7次）方面在所有球员中排名第一。哈兰德连续三个比赛周进球，每次都获得最多三分奖励。黑猫队本赛季两场客场比赛均失球。在其他地方，摩根·吉布斯-怀特（800万英镑）是对阵考文垂城的一个有趣的选择。这位英格兰中场球员在过去三周比赛中完成了三次进攻，并为诺丁汉森林主罚点球。主场对阵积分榜垫底的考文垂，上一场丢了五个球，看起来已经准备好进攻回报。本赛季到目前为止，没有哪位球员比吉布斯-怀特创造了更多的绝佳机会（4），他已经被超过 370,000 名幻想队主帅买入。

news.title: Don't miss your new-look Chelsea Women programme against Birmingham City!

news.body_en: Nelly Las gives us an insight into her journey to Chelsea in an exclusive interview in the matchday programme for this weekend’s WSL fixture against Birmingham City at Stamford Bridge. The England Under-20s full-back is settling in nicely to life with the Blues and is loving the levels she is seeing every day in training here. 'I’m really enjoying it,' she says. 'All the girls are really nice, and they’ve really welcomed me. Training’s been really intense, which I’ve really enjoyed as well, and I think it’s great for me to develop as a player. 'You just see all of the players, and how high-level they are. Being around that every day, not just on the pitch, but also off the pitch, and seeing their standards, has been really great. 'I think this is the place I want to be, especially because I’m young. I can really learn from them.' Elsewhere in the programme, there’s a pull-out poster of Sjoeke Nusken, while we put the spotlight on Veerle Buurman to find out more about her career and life away from the pitch, and Aggie Beever-Jones takes us through her journey so far after reaching 100 games for Chelsea. Sandy Baltimore recalls some of her “firsts and favs” in life, and of course there is all the info you need ahead of the game in question, not to mention the latest columns from Sonia Bompastor and Erin Cuthbert. Make sure you pick up your copy from the programme sellers around Stamford Bridge!

news.title: Blues duo selected in England squad
news.title_zh: 蓝军二人组入选英格兰队
news.body_en: Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers have been selected in the England squad for the upcoming September and October international break. The Three Lions will play four matches during an extended FIFA window as they kick off the new UEFA Nations League campaign. Rogers retains his place in the squad from the summer’s FIFA World Cup, where he made seven appearances for England as they reached the semi-finals and then beat France in the third-place play-off. Palmer returns to the squad for this international window, having last been selected by England boss Thomas Tuchel for the pair of friendlies in March. The 24-year-old will be hoping to add to his 14 caps and two goals for the Three Lions. Palmer and Rogers' inclusions come after a brilliant start to the season at club level, with both dovetailing alongside Joao Pedro to devastating effect in the Premier League; they have produced a combined five goals and three assists across our four top-flight matches. England will begin their Nations League campaign by hosting World Cup winners Spain at Wembley Stadium on Saturday 26 September, before back-to-back away games in Czechia on Tuesday 29 September and Croatia on Saturday 3 October. They conclude their four matches during this international window back in London on Tuesday 6 October, when Croatia will be the visitors to Wembley. news.title: Chelsea FC Women launches best-in-class Player Maternity Policy as part of new family-friendly player care framework
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足推出一流的球员生育政策，作为新的家庭友好型球员护理框架的一部分
news.body_en: Enhanced policy provides fully paid leave, personalised pregnancy support and dedicated return-to-play medical care, alongside new adoption, parental leave and fertility support. Chelsea FC Women (CFCW) has today announced a new, enhanced suite of family-friendly policies designed to provide our players with greater financial security, personalised care and comprehensive support through pregnancy, parenthood and other family-building journeys, as the club continues our ambition to set the standard for player care in women’s football. Chelsea FC has always been proud to offer industry-leading maternity support, but players face a unique challenge in balancing peak physical performance on the pitch with the demands of pregnancy, post-partum recovery and balancing motherhood with their return to play. We are therefore setting out a new suite of policies to provide wraparound, tailored support for our players that will better help them navigate starting a family. The centrepiece of the new framework is the club’s Player Maternity Policy, offering personalised support throughout pregnancy and dedicated medical care to support each player’s individual return to professional football. The policy has been developed to give players greater financial security and confidence planning for parenthood, recognises that every player’s journey is different, while ensuring their health and wellbeing remain the priority throughout pregnancy and their transition back to elite sport. The club’s enhanced approach includes: Personalised support throughout pregnancy, with the right to access private scans and delivery options Post-partum recovery support, led by the club’s industry-leading experts covering physical, mental and emotional aspects of postnatal health Financial support for a partner or nanny to travel to away fixtures up to one year after a player’s return to play, to ensure those early months of returning to play post-delivery are fully supported Enhanced adoption and parental leave policies, recognising that there is no single path to becoming a parent Subsidised childcare, a contribution to childcare costs when a player returns to rehab or training These policies follow our recently announced partnership with Fertility Plus, which includes the creation of a Player Value in Kind Fund to financially support players exploring their fertility and family-building options. The breadth of policies has been comprehensively reviewed and revised as part of CFCW’s pursuit to be never done challenging ourself and never done pushing for progress. Most recently this ambition has been brought to life with all of the team’s Barclays Women’s Super League matches now being played at Stamford Bridge, through working with industry-leading partners delivering campaign-winning work and enhancing policies to offer our players the very best care, not only on the pitch, but in all areas of life and at every stage of their careers. Aki Mandhar, Chief Executive Officer for Chelsea FC Women, said: ‘There is no single path to becoming a parent, and our responsibility is to ensure our players have access to the support, security and care they deserve, whatever their individual journey looks like. Our enhanced Player Maternity Policy, alongside our adoption, parental leave and fertility support, is designed to give our players confidence that they will be supported throughout their careers with us.’ Phil Radley, Sporting Director for Chelsea FC Women, added: ‘We are proud of the progress we are making, but we are never done looking for ways to do more. Our ambition is to build the best women’s sports organisation in the world; one that truly values its players and gives them everything they need to thrive – both as athletes and as people.’
news.body_zh: 强化政策提供全薪休假、个性化怀孕支持和专门的重返赛场医疗护理，以及新收养、育儿假和生育支持。切尔西足球俱乐部女足 (CFCW) 今天宣布了一套新的、增强的家庭友好政策，旨在为我们的球员提供更大的财务保障、个性化护理以及在怀孕、生育和其他家庭建设过程中的全面支持，同时俱乐部继续致力于为女足球员护理制定标准。切尔西足球俱乐部一直为提供行业领先的产妇支持而感到自豪，但球员们面临着独特的挑战，需要平衡球场上的最佳身体表现与怀孕、产后恢复的需求，以及平衡母性与重返赛场之间的关系。因此，我们制定了一套新的政策，为我们的玩家提供全方位、量身定制的支持，更好地帮助他们组建家庭。新框架的核心是俱乐部的球员生育政策，在整个怀孕期间提供个性化支持和专门的医疗护理，以支持每位球员重返职业足球。该政策的制定是为了给球员更大的经济保障和信心，为父母做计划，认识到每个球员的旅程都是不同的，同时确保他们的健康和福祉在整个怀孕期间和重返精英运动的过渡过程中仍然是首要任务。俱乐部的强化方法包括： 怀孕期间的个性化支持，有权获得私人扫描和分娩选项 产后恢复支持，由俱乐部业界领先的专家领导，涵盖产后健康的身体、心理和情感方面 为伴侣或保姆提供财务支持，在球员重返比赛后一年内前往客场比赛，以确保产后返回比赛的最初几个月得到充分支持 加强收养和育儿假政策，认识到成为父母没有单一的途径补贴儿童保育，当球员返回康复中心或训练时支付儿童保育费用这些政策遵循我们最近宣布的与 Fertility Plus 的合作伙伴关系，其中包括创建球员实物价值基金，以在经济上支持球员探索他们的生育和家庭建设选择。作为CFCW永不停歇地挑战自我、永不止步地推动进步的追求的一部分，对政策的广度进行了全面审查和修订。最近，这一雄心壮志随着球队在斯坦福桥举行的所有巴克莱女子超级联赛比赛而得以实现，通过与行业领先的合作伙伴合作，提供赢得竞选的工作并加强政策，为我们的球员提供最好的照顾，不仅在球场上，而且在生活的各个领域和职业生涯的每个阶段。切尔西女足首席执行官阿基·曼达尔 (Aki Mandhar) 表示：“成为父母没有单一的途径，我们的责任是确保我们的球员能够获得他们应得的支持、安全和照顾，无论他们的个人经历如何。我们强化的球员生育政策，以及我们的收养、育儿假和生育支持，旨在让我们的球员相信，他们将在整个职业生涯中得到我们的支持。”切尔西女足体育总监菲尔·拉德利补充道：“我们为我们正在取得的进步感到自豪，但我们永远不会停止寻找做得更多的方法。我们的目标是建立世界上最好的女子体育组织；一个真正重视球员并为他们提供成长所需的一切的球队——无论是作为运动员还是作为人。
